tenders.scope_summary: Tender for the development of a digital twin for a submarine. The project is located in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India.
key_points: Key Location: Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India.

tenders.title: UPGRADE THE EXISTING 5G USE CASE LAB WITH 5G INDUSTRIAL IOT (IIOT) GATEWAY
tenders.scope_summary: Online bids are invited for upgrading an existing 5G Use Case Lab with a 5G Industrial IoT (IIoT) Gateway at NCA-T, Ghaziabad. The contract will initially be for one year, with a possible extension for another year based on satisfactory performance.
key_points: Bidder must deal with Wireless and 5G Equipment.
Average Annual Turnover of not less than Rs. 3.0 Lakh for the last three Financial Years (2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25).
Experience: Successfully executed/completed similar supply over the last 1 year to at least 2 government organizations/educational institutions, for a value of at least Rs. 10 Lakh.

tenders.title: Procurement, Supply of Goods, Tools & Equipment for an International Standard IToT in Electrician Trade at ITI Vyara, Gujarat, India (AR-VR Training Set Up)
tenders.tendering_authority: National Cooperative Consumers' Federation of India Ltd. (NCCF), Ahmedabad Branch
tenders.scope_summary: NCCF invites bids for the procurement and supply of goods, tools, and equipment, including an AR-VR training setup, for an International Standard IToT in Electrician Trade at ITI Vyara, Gujarat. The vision is to establish multiple Centres of Excellence (CoEs) and Institutes of Training of Trainers (iToTs) across the state.
key_points: Vendor must not be blacklisted/debarred by any Government/PSU/Autonomous body.
Performance Security: 5% of contract value, validity up to completion of contract including warranty period.

tenders.title: Appointment of Consultant for “Digital Transformation of VOC Port: Strategic Roadmap development and Implementation support”
tenders.scope_summary: The V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority is seeking a consultancy firm for process study, DPR preparation, and PMU services, and transaction advisory for business process enhancement. The scope includes Digital Twin, IoT, Cybersecurity Architecture, and implementation of Just-In-Time (JIT) systems.
key_points: Selection Methodology: Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) 80:20.
Contract period: 12 months, with possible extension.
Technical Presentation on approach & methodology scheduled for March 02, 2026.
Subcontracting for specialized parts is allowed.

tenders.title: Procurement of 500 Nos. Asset Performance Management System (APMS) for different capacity Transformers
tenders.scope_summary: HESCO invites sealed bids for the procurement of 500 Asset Performance Management Systems (APMS) for various capacity transformers as per Specification No. DD-76:2023. The bidding is open to all registered bidders on EPADS (www.eprocure.gov.pk).
key_points: Bid Security must be submitted to Manager Material Management HESCO on or before the closing date.
Bidding conducted in line with 36(a) procedure of Public Procurement Rules 2004.
